newsitem.title: USA: Alaska Airlines starts work on new cargo terminal.
newsitem.headline: Alaska Airlines starts work on new cargo terminal.

text.p: Alaska Airlines said it broke ground Monday for a new US$8 million air cargo terminal at its Anchorage International Airport hub, the airline said.
The new facility, to be completed by next June, will give Alaska over 65,000 square feet of floor space.

The airline said it carried more than 93.2 million pounds of freight and mail into and out of Anchorage last year, and assuming normal growth over the next few years, that will grow to about 120 million in 2002. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
